faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Kharagpur is 20-08-2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Engineering or Technology Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or equivalent national exams, with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is GATE qualification mandatory for all candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: GATE qualification is mandatory only for candidates applying with a B.Tech/B.E. degree in Chemical Engineering. Other candidates may have qualified through other national-level examinations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years. However, age relaxation may be provided as per the sponsor agency's rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection methods for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will involve a Merit List followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
